classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: The `Tracking` class in the namespace `Opencart\\Catalog\\Controller\\Account` handles account tracking functionalities, including displaying the tracking page and providing autocomplete search results for products. It integrates with the OpenCart system to manage user tokens, affiliate data, breadcrumbs, and product search results for customer tracking purposes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the account tracking page, verifying customer login, setting up breadcrumbs, loading models and language files, and rendering the tracking view.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an AJAX endpoint that returns a JSON list of product suggestions based on search and tracking parameters, used for autocomplete product searches within the account tracking context.
